name: Proof of Process (PoP) EAT Profile
description: IETF RATS Entity Attestation Token (EAT) profile for CPoE's proof-of-process authorship attestation, as referenced by CWT/EAT claim key 265 (eat_profile) in tokens minted by apps/cpoe_cli.
basedOn: draft-condrey-rats-pop (individual submission, expired 2026-08-15, not yet WG-adopted)
notes: Published under this domain because urn:ietf:params: is IANA-controlled and this profile was never IETF-WG-adopted; a dereferenceable URI needs no registration. See also https://writerslogic.com/.well-known/cpoe-profile-1.0.json for the sibling evidence-packet profile.
